summary: The root of one window: its run is the window's lifetime, and it starts every other page driver as a child for as long as they are needed.
creates: the window node, with an actor ID from the random source and its library from the page address
the composition's catalogues (types, rules, operators, modules, renderers) as constant model nodes
one child run each of store, layout, paint, dispatch, views, preview setup, diagnostics and the legacy mirror

faults.when: The store can't load the window's profile or library.
The one-time migration's dry run doesn't match; nothing is written.

lifetime: From the page loading until the window closes; aborting its token ends everything in the window.

x-friction.gap: Which library a window works in (the person's own or the verification copy) is chosen by the page address, and the host keeps two hand-made copies of every service.
x-friction.closes: Several graphs side by side, chosen per window.
